title: It's 2 a.m. and I'm in the archives.
caption:
It's 2 a.m. and Cancer is 400 photos deep, holding a framed receipt.
Missing someone means it mattered, not that you have to go back. Write it in your notes, then rest.
Who else has a 2 a.m. archive?
